caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, brown-colored ceramic container with a slightly flared rim at the top and two small handles on opposite sides near the upper edge. The container has a lid that fits into the top opening, through which a wooden stick is inserted vertically in the center. On the front side of the container, there is a blue decorative design featuring a series of lines and circular patterns. The overall tone of the drawing is muted and earthy, with the brown hues of the ceramic contrasting against the blue of the design. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s name, "RACINE VERNER," appears at the bottom.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
